reviewer: Kimi actual visual review of the exact 156x210 source and enlarged source-page 18 crop, complete opaque RGB raw and native face crop, unchanged naiwa reference, and full white/cyan/source-alpha/RGB-no-alpha sheet/evidence. RGB art was rejected for missing brows before any alpha operation; no derivative or repair receipt was created.

remaining_reasons: The source has distinct dark eyebrows above both eyes, but the complete RGB raw and native face crop leave the entire yellow brow area above both green eyes bare. Restore the source's two separate dark eyebrow shapes while retaining the cap, right-facing half-smile and all other visible features. This is an RGB hair-features-v1 failure and must not be hidden with source-alpha repair.
entries.positive_observation: The dark green-black cap retains its glossy visor, gold piping/cords, separate upper eagle and lower wreath/cockade. Hair remains covered without invented sideburns, glasses, moustache or beard, and there is one restrained closed-mouth half-smile. The three-quarter right-facing pose, crop and pronounced visor shadow remain. The dark olive-black uniform keeps gold shoulder ornaments, elaborate gold-embroidered red collar patches, pale piping and one small dark-centered pale throat cross. The rounded chin meets a short broad fitted collar, and the pale warm grey-beige painted backplate fills the rectangle. These correct properties do not offset the clearly absent eyebrows.
entries.visible_limitations: Fine cap, collar and throat insignia are too small for exact internal transcription and are not rejection grounds. The source's measured softer alpha pixels are also not an art rejection reason; the decisive issue is the clearly empty native brow area, which is plainly visible rather than unresolved detail.
